remaining_gaps: First end of all 14 clauses not established. The Committee (EO 11849, 1975-04-01) has no term of its own. The only candidate early end is the Federal Advisory Committee Act sec. 14(a)(2) two-year limit (not later than 1977-04-01 unless renewed 'by appropriate action'), which is an outer bound and a conditional one, and the Act's text is not an evidence record of this kit dossier, so it cannot be cited as an end. EO 11948 (signed 1976-12-20, effective 1976-12-31) neither lists nor revokes this Committee, but that is neutral: its two-year mark had not yet arrived in December 1976, so omission from the continuance list does not show lapse. EO 12110 sec. 1-103(b) (effective 1978-12-31) revokes the order as one whose committee 'terminated or whose work is completed', which is only an upper bound. Needed: proof of the Committee's actual termination (or a renewal and its date), e.g. the GSA annual reports on Federal Advisory Committees for 1975-1978 or the Committee's charter and termination record.
whole_order_end not set until the first-end question is resolved (latest possible date 1978-12-31, EO 12110).

First end of the clauses tied to the Committee's existence not established. Under EO 11971 sec. 3(b) the Committee terminates thirty days after submission of its report unless the President extends its duration; under sec. 3(a) as amended by EO 11982 (signed 1977-04-29) the report was due 'no later than June 11, 1977'. A report deadline is not an end, and the held record (own-term TERM records are report_deadline/condition kinds with no date) contains neither the actual submission date nor any presidential extension. EO 12110 sec. 1-103(d) (effective 1978-12-31) revokes the order as one whose committee 'terminated or whose work is completed', an upper bound only. Needed: the date the Committee's report was submitted to the President and the Attorney General (and whether the President extended its duration), e.g. Weekly Compilation of Presidential Documents / Public Papers of the Presidents: Jimmy Carter 1977-1978 or Department of Justice records.
whole_order_end not set until the report date and any extension are established (latest possible date 1978-12-31).

First end of the Commission's clauses not established. Under EO 11973 sec. 9 the Commission terminates sixty days after transmittal of its final report to the President, and sec. 3 requires the final report by 1978-04-01. A report deadline is not an end, and no held source gives the actual transmittal date (the preliminary report was due 1977-09-01). EO 12110 sec. 1-103(e) (effective 1978-12-31) revokes the order as one whose commission 'terminated or whose work is completed', an upper bound only. Needed: the date the final report of the President's Commission on Mental Health was transmitted to the President (Public Papers of the Presidents: Jimmy Carter 1978, Weekly Compilation of Presidential Documents, or the Commission's report front matter), then 60 days computed from it.
whole_order_end not set until the transmittal date is established (latest possible date 1978-12-31).

First end of the Commission's clauses not established. Under EO 11998 sec. 9 the Commission terminates thirty days after submitting its report, and sec. 2(c) requires the report by 1978-03-15. A report deadline is not an end, and no held source gives the actual submission date. EO 12110 sec. 1-103(f) (effective 1978-12-31) revokes the order as one whose commission 'terminated or whose work is completed', an upper bound only. Needed: the date the President's Commission on Military Compensation submitted its report through the Secretary of Defense (the Commission's report front matter, Public Papers of the Presidents: Jimmy Carter 1978, or Department of Defense records), then 30 days computed from it.
whole_order_end not set until the report date is established (latest possible date 1978-12-31).

First end not established for secs. 1, 2 and 4 and Schedules 1-4. EO 12010 sec. 4 supersedes EO 11941 but states no effective date for the supersession; its sec. 3 makes the uniformed-services rates effective 1977-10-01 (a held calendar date) but every other adjustment effective 'on the first day of the first applicable pay period beginning on or after October 1, 1977', which is not a calendar date and is not fixed by any held source (an OPM or Treasury pay-period calendar for 1977 is needed). Whether the superseding order displaced the old rates on signing (1977-09-28) or on those effective dates is therefore not settled.

First end not established for sec. 3 and Schedules 5-7 (Vice President, Executive Schedule, congressional and judicial salaries). EO 12010 does not re-set these rates, so some other 1977 instrument (statute or order) replaced them; no held source identifies it or its date, and EO 11941 sec. 5 (superseding EO 11883) is a performed command whose completion date is likewise not stated. Needed: the instrument and effective date that next set Executive Schedule, congressional and judicial salaries after 1976-10-01 (e.g. the Executive Salary Cost of Living Adjustment Act, Pub. L. 94-82, as applied in 1977), and the 1977 pay-period calendar.
whole_order_end not set until every clause end is established (latest possible date is the first applicable pay period beginning on or after 1977-10-01).

First end of the three amending paragraphs (item 30 of the Tariff, revocation of secs. V-49 to V-52, and the amendment of sec. V-54(d)) not established. EO 9521 (1945-02-13) revokes EO 9303 only 'as of the dates of issuance of the orders or regulations of the Secretary of State that cover the subject-matter of and supersede' it, and no held source identifies any such Secretary of State order or regulation or its date. EO 9591 (1945) and EO 9767 (1946) still describe the Tariff as amended by EO 9303, and EO 10697 sec. 7 revokes it only 'to the extent that [it has] not heretofore been revoked or superseded' (effective 1957-03-01), which is an upper bound, not a first end. Needed: Department of State regulations or orders issued under EOs 9452 and 9521 (22 CFR part 105 / Foreign Service Regulations, 1945-1957) that name EO 9303 or its sections, or a source showing none did.
whole_order_end not set until the first-end question is resolved (latest possible date 1957-03-01, EO 10697).

First end of paragraph 2 (amendment and partial revocation of section V-23 of the Foreign Service Regulations, EO 7968) not established. EO 10697 sec. 7 revokes EO 9591 only 'to the extent that [it has] not heretofore been revoked or superseded' (effective 1957-03-01), and section V-23 may have been displaced earlier by a Secretary of State regulation under EO 9521 (effective as each regulation issues), the Foreign Service Act of 1946 or later departmental finance regulations; none is held. The 1957-03-01 date is established for paragraph 1 (Tariff items 6, 8, 34) only because EO 10697 replaced the whole Tariff, and cannot be carried to paragraph 2 without a source for V-23. Needed: the Department of State regulation or order that superseded section V-23 (22 CFR 105.23 history, 1945-1957), or a source showing V-23 was still in force on 1957-03-01.
whole_order_end not set because one paragraph remains open (latest possible date 1957-03-01, EO 10697).

First end not established for either permission. Both permissions concern 'officers and employees of the Social Security Board, Federal Security Agency' acting 'upon recommendation of the Board', and the Board was abolished by Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1946 (effective 1946-07-16), its functions passing to the Federal Security Administrator. The Plan's text is not a record of this kit dossier, and no held source shows whether the permissions ceased with the Board's abolition (a statutory end, 1946-07-16) or carried over to the successor's personnel until EO 11408 (signed 1968-04-25; no stated effective date) revoked the 1873 prohibition they excepted. EO 11408 (the dossier shows its sources reading as both a whole and a partial ending) is an upper bound only. Needed: the text and effective date of Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1946 (60 Stat. 1095) and its transfer of Board personnel and functions, plus any rule on references to the Board.
whole_order_end not set until the first-end question is resolved (latest possible date 1968-04-25, EO 11408).
